parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

init: The bandwidth plan is being initialized.
active: The bandwidth plan is available.
binded: The bandwidth plan is associated.
binding: The bandwidth plan is being associated.
unbinding: The bandwidth plan is being disassociated.
updating: The bandwidth plan is being updated.
finacialLocked: The bandwidth plan is locked due to overdue payments.
locked: The bandwidth plan is locked
parameters.help_zh:
带宽包的状态，取值：

init：初始化。

active：可用。

binded：已绑定。

binding：绑定中。

unbinding：解绑中。

updating：更新中。

finacialLocked：欠费锁定。

locked：已锁定
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The type of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

Basic: a basic bandwidth plan
CrossDomain: a cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan

If you call this operation on the China site (aliyun.com), you can set Type only to Basic
parameters.help_zh:
带宽包的类型，取值：

Basic：基础带宽包。

CrossDomain：跨地域加速包。

中国站仅支持取值Basic
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the bandwidth plan. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
带宽包的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the bandwidth plan. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
带宽包的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

BandwidthPackages.description_en: The details of the bandwidth plans

items.description_en: The ID of the GA instance that is associated with the bandwidth plan
items.description_zh: 带宽包绑定的全球加速实例ID

BandwidthType.description_en:
The type of the bandwidth. Valid values:

Basic
Enhanced
Advanced
BandwidthType.description_zh:
带宽类型。

Basic：标准加速带宽。

Enhanced：增强加速带宽。

Advanced：精品加速带宽

BillingType.description_en:
The metering method that is used when you use the pay-as-you-go billing method.

PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer.
PayBY95: pay-by-95th-percentile
BillingType.description_zh:
后付费计费方式。
PayByTraffic：流量计费。
PayBY95：95计费

CbnGeographicRegionIdA.description_en:
Area A of the cross-region acceleration bandwidth plan. China-mainland is returned.

This parameter is returned only if you call the operation on the international site (alibabacloud.com)
CbnGeographicRegionIdA.description_zh:
跨地域加速包的互通区域A。仅返回为China-mainland（中国内地）。

仅国际站支持返回该参数

CbnGeographicRegionIdB.description_en:
Area B of the cross-region acceleration bandwidth plan. Global is returned.

This parameter is returned only if you call the operation on the international site (alibabacloud.com)
CbnGeographicRegionIdB.description_zh:
跨地域加速包的互通区域B。仅返回为Global（全球）。

仅国际站支持返回该参数

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the bandwidth plan.

PREPAY: subscription. This is the default value.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型。
PREPAY（默认值）：预付费，即包年包月。
POSTPAY：后付费，即按量付费
